mapper.delete: DELETE FROM park_bookmark WHERE mem_id = #{memId} AND park_id = #{parkId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.sd_nm AS sdNm, d.sgg_nm AS sggNm, d.park_nm AS parkNm, d.oper_tm AS operTm, d.hldy, d.fcs, d.fcar, d.oper_inst AS operInst, d.telno, d.addr, d.use_amt AS useAmt, d.view_count AS viewCount, d.park_img AS parkImg, ST_AsText(d.geom) AS geomWkt FROM park_bookmark b JOIN dog_park d ON b.park_id = d.id WHERE b.mem_id = #{memId} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
